# Brick Instructions For You

This website helps users find LEGO building instruction videos by set number, year, theme and booklet.

Important pages:
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/2025/ - LEGO 2025 instructions
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/2026/ - LEGO 2026 instructions
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/themes/ - LEGO theme pages
- https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/search/ - set number search

YouTube playlists:
- 2025: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?app=desktop&list=PLQcpf5VzBO0r7AYWpgFpJcBfPDB8rf81V&cbrd=1
- 2026: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQcpf5VzBO0plGlm2VNlbO53VFPuqbJZv

Each set page supports All Books plus individual Book 1, Book 2, Book 3+ video matching.
